chunks: I will fill Hell with you and with those who follow you, all of them.
ai.seo_question: Who will fill Hell according to Surah Sad verse 85?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as God's declaration to the archetypal disbeliever, with some scholars linking it to Pharaoh or Qarun, emphasizing the inevitability of divine retribution for those who lead others astray. The phrase 'from among them' (مِنْهُمْ) highlights the collective accountability of the followers who align themselves with the leader's arrogance, reinforcing the concept of *Tawassul* (intercession) being rejected for the misguided masses. This serves as a practical warning for the community to distinguish between true leadership and arrogant authority.
